in_sanskrit.name: गगन्देep
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One whose depth is as deep as the sky.

in_marathi.name: Gagandeep
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ocean of Virtues
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gagandeep हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gagandeep means one who embodies virtues and qualities of the ocean. The ocean is a symbol of endlessness, depth, and power. The name Gagandeep is believed to bring prosperity, intelligence, and victory to the one who bears it.
